# XNXX.COM

> Free adult video platform for browsing, searching, and discovering porn videos, categories, tags, and performers.

XNXX provides free streaming adult videos with discovery features such as trending pages, category browsing, tag indexes, performer directories, and search. The site structure emphasizes video listings and taxonomy pages rather than formal product documentation.

## Main Discovery

- [Homepage](https://xnxx.health/): Main entry point featuring highlighted videos, categories, and navigation to core browsing areas.
- [Best Videos](https://xnxx.health/best): Curated ranking page for popular and featured videos across the platform.
- [Most Viewed Videos](https://xnxx.health/hits): Popularity-based listing of the most watched videos on the site.
- [New Videos](https://xnxx.health/new): Recently added videos in chronological order for fresh content discovery.
- [Long Videos](https://xnxx.health/long): Dedicated listing for longer-duration videos.
- [Random Video](https://xnxx.health/random): Randomized discovery endpoint for exploring videos without filters.

## Search and Taxonomy

- [Search](https://xnxx.health/search): Search results interface for finding videos by keyword.
- [Tags Directory](https://xnxx.health/tags): Alphabetical index of tags used to classify videos and support navigation.
- [Categories](https://xnxx.health/c/): Category browsing area for exploring videos by broad content type.
- [Channels](https://xnxx.health/channels): Directory of channels and publishers contributing video collections.
- [Pornstars](https://xnxx.health/pornstars): Performer directory with profile pages and associated videos.
- [Profiles](https://xnxx.health/profiles): User or uploader profile listings for browsing contributed content.
